name: Familial Dilated Cardiomyopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: ESC Diagnostic Criteria for Dilated Cardiomyopathy

criteria.description: Left or biventricular dilation on echocardiography or cardiac MRI
Left ventricular systolic dysfunction with reduced ejection fraction (<45%)
Positive family history of dilated cardiomyopathy or sudden cardiac death
Identification of pathogenic mutation in known DCM-associated gene
Exclusion of secondary causes such as ischemic heart disease, hypertension, or valvular disease

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of ventricular dilation and systolic dysfunction with exclusion of secondary causes; family history or genetic confirmation supports diagnosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended for confirmation and family screening.

common.notes: Common symptom of reduced cardiac output

occasional.notes: Due to arrhythmias or low cardiac output

laboratory: Elevated B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) or NT-proBNP
Elevated liver enzymes in congestive hepatopathy
Possible mild elevation of troponin in acute decompensation
imaging: Echocardiography showing ventricular dilation and reduced ejection fraction
Cardiac MRI demonstrating myocardial fibrosis and dilation
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly and pulmonary congestion
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in genes such as TTN, LMNA, MYH7, and DSP
other: Electrocardiogram abnormalities including conduction delays and arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: Regional wall motion abnormalities on imaging
Presence of significant coronary artery stenosis
Left ventricular hypertrophy rather than dilation
Normal or reduced ventricular volumes with impaired diastolic filling
Signs of infiltrative disease on biopsy or imaging

redFlags: Rapid progression of heart failure symptoms
Recurrent syncope or documented ventricular arrhythmias
Family history of sudden cardiac death under age 50
references: Elliott P, et al. Classification of the cardiomyopathies: a position statement from the European Society of Cardiology Working Group on Myocardial and Pericardial Diseases. Eur Heart J. 2008;29(2):270-276.
McNally EM, et al. Dilated Cardiomyopathy: Genetic Determinants and Mechanisms. Circ Res. 2017;121(7):731-748.
Towbin JA, et al. Inherited Cardiomyopathies. Circ Res. 2019;121(7):819-837.
